scenes.say: In October twenty twenty-six, Google launched AI chips into space, to test whether data centres could orbit Earth.

scenes.say: Why? On Earth, AI is running short of grid connections, land and water. In the right orbit, solar panels almost never go dark. Google says they can produce up to eight times more power.

scenes.say: Starcloud has already trained a small AI model on an Nvidia chip in orbit. SpaceX has asked to launch up to a million computing satellites. Only about sixteen thousand eight hundred working satellites exist today.

scenes.say: The catch: there's no air to carry heat away. Chips must radiate it through huge panels, around a hundred tonnes per megawatt, by one estimate. Add radiation, and no repairs.
